title: Exclusive race and sports wagering licences (Queensland)
summary: The Wagering Act 1998 (Qld) lets the Minister grant race and sports wagering licences only to UBET during an exclusivity period running 30 years from 1 July 2014.
direction_rationale: An exclusive licence keeps all other operators out of the licensed wagering market.

review.notes: Drafted by AI-assisted desk research on 17 November 2026 (phase 6 of the levers re-evaluation, batch 1) from the law quoted. Not yet checked: verify the description, industries and assessment before use.

assessment.summary: Until 30 June 2044, only UBET, the company the Act names, may be granted Queensland's race and sports wagering licences. A statutory exclusive right; interstate and online bookmakers compete for bets, but not under these licences.

marks.reason: No one but UBET may be granted a race or sports wagering licence until 2044.
Shelters the totalizator and retail wagering business from local rivals.

assessment.confidence_note: The exclusivity and its 30-year period are explicit.

responsible.note: The Office of Liquor and Gaming Regulation sits in the department; not checked against the administrative arrangements order.
